units.name: Quaternary deposits
units.rock: Sand, gravel, till, clay and peat; the model resolves hydraulic sublayers through cell conductivity.

units.name: Quaternary sublayer 2
units.rock: Mixed glacial and post-glacial sediment; locally sand/gravel or low-permeability till/clay.

units.name: Quaternary sublayer 3
units.rock: Mixed glacial sediment; model sublayer rather than a formal stratigraphic unit.

units.name: Quaternary sublayer 4
units.rock: Mixed basal glacial sediment; model sublayer rather than a formal stratigraphic unit.

units.name: Jurassic aquifer package
units.rock: Predominantly clastic regional package, normally absent from Estonia.

units.name: Jurassic aquitard package

units.name: Triassic package
units.rock: Predominantly clastic regional package, normally absent from Estonia.

units.name: Middle Permian aquifer package
units.rock: Regional carbonate/evaporite package, normally absent from Estonia.

units.name: Middle Permian aquitard package
units.rock: Low-permeability part of the regional Permian package; normally absent from Estonia.

units.name: Carboniferous aquifer package
units.rock: Regional carbonate and clastic package, normally absent from Estonia.

units.name: Carboniferous aquitard package
units.rock: Low-permeability part of the regional Carboniferous package; normally absent from Estonia.

units.rock: Limestone, dolostone and marl; groundwater occurs mainly in fractures and bed contacts.

units.rock: Predominantly limestone with marl and locally argillaceous or dolomitised intervals.

units.name: Middle Ordovician package
units.rock: Predominantly limestone, including argillaceous, kerogenous and locally biohermal limestone.

units.name: Lower Ordovician package
units.rock: Mixed basal sandstone, graptolitic argillite, clay, glauconitic sandstone and limestone; not a single rock type.

units.name: Cambrian terrigenous aquifer package
units.rock: Fine- to medium-grained sandstone and silty sandstone; a broad model package rather than one Estonian formation.

units.name: Gdov Formation aquifer
